contexts.text: Without charity there is disjunction; and when there is disjunction, he is left to himself or proprium.
Hence it is evident what disjoins the external man from the internal...
When love becomes none, disjunction takes place; and when there is disjunction, destruction and extirpation follows.
That disjoining truth should not appear. Signified.
If the will is of evil, good and truths disjoin, not conjoin; but if there is any will of good, they do not disjoin, but conjoin.
Cursed are they that curse thee = that he who disjoins himself shall be disjoined.
In the Original Language, Luz means recession, thus disjunction; which takes place when truth is put in the first place, and good is neglected, thus when truth alone is in the ultimate of order...
Disjunction by virtue of a free state according to the faith of that good. Signified.
Not to permit to kiss = disjunction.
Disjunction as to life and doctrine. Signified.

How shall I do this great evil, and sin against God? = that thus there would be disjunction and no conjunction. Evil and sin = disjunction and no conjunction... Regarded in itself, evil, and also sin, is nothing but disjunction from good; evil itself consists in disunion. Explained.
The evil of the love of self disjoins him not only from the Lord, but also from Heaven... And when many do this in one Society, it follows that they are all disjoined...

I do remember my sins this day = concerning a state of disjunction... To remember sins is to be conjoined with those things which are of inverted order, consequently, to be disjoined from the Natural which is represented by Pharaoh; for that which is conjoined with those things which are in inverted order, is disjoined from those which are in order.
Sin not against the child = lest they be disjoined. To sin = disjunction; for all sin disjoins.
Opposite loves, namely, the loves of self and the world, are not conjunctions, but disjunctions... For as soon as the one does not favour the other, there is disjunction.

Hence it was evident to me... what spiritual disjunction is, which is enmity and hatred, namely, that the mind of the one presents itself in the mind of the other with the thought and will of destroying him, whence comes rejection.
Hence with those (who are out of Heaven) there is disjunction...

As the longing of truth to good conjoins, so the longing of falsity to evil disjoins; and that which disjoins also destroys; hence by salt in the opposite sense is signified the destruction and devastation of truth and good. Illustrated.
It does not appear that loving one's own, that is, one's self in another, disjoins; when yet it so disjoins, that in proportion as anyone has loved another in this manner, he afterwards hates him.
What is heterogeneous and discordant effects disjunction and absence.
Spheres... conjoin and disjoin two married partners not only from without, but also from within.
That spiritual cold in marriages is a disunion of souls, and a disjunction of minds...
How affections of love conjoin, and disjoin.
